rules.R1: Identity: date of birth first, then postcode; two wrong answers in total end the check.
rules.R2: Identity answers: date of birth sent as DDMMYYYY (eight digits, no separators); postcode in capitals with one space before the last three characters.
rules.R3: Business days: Mon-Fri except 2026-11-30, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28, 2027-01-01, 2027-01-04, plus 2026-12-11 added by the memo; 2026-12-24 is a business day.
rules.R4: Bands (memo): early 1-14 days, mid 15-30, late 31-60, banded per product on days_in_arrears.
rules.R5: Deadlines: early = 8th business day after today; mid = today + 14 calendar days, moved back to the previous business day if not a business day; late = last business day of the month, or of next month if today is that day.
rules.R6: Floor: 30% of arrears_amount rounded up to the next whole pound (exact pounds unchanged); monthly_payment is not the floor.
rules.R7: Persuasion: attempts early 1 / mid 2 / late 3, opening ask included; ladder full today, full on 5th business day (or deadline if earlier), floor on deadline.
rules.R8: Third-party callback: today or next two business days, 09:00-18:30 inclusive (memo), later than now.
rules.R9: Close codes per situation, using memo code `declined` for refusals.
rules.R10: Notes: every product ending without a promise gets a note (refusal noted `declined` per memo); no notes on any transfer.
rules.R11: Transfers: payment plan -> arrears_solutions, person -> customer_care, hardship -> care_team.
rules.R12: create_promise amount is sent in pence as a whole number.
